fight.arena: Side-on, landscape, 960×600 world. The party stands on the left third; the horde enters from the right edge.

formation.backRule: Reachable only by ranged enemies and leapers

fight.falls: A downed cook stays down until Rise. Guests and Scraps are not cooks and do not count toward the end.
fight.end: The fight ends at 0:00 or when the fifth cook falls, whichever comes first.
fight.rise: At the end every cook rises, five Signatures fire together, and everything on the field and in the queue is finished. Finished kills are shown and never scored.

boards: Daily Table (party best of the day)

fight.simulation: Fixed-step, seeded. The daily seed fixes the conditions and the Champion order; the run seed varies wave rolls, Ingredient drops and Champion entry points.

units.note: The bulk of the first Course.
Packs of six; goes for the back row if it can.
Splits into two Spores (15 HP) on death. Spores count as kills.
The rival table’s rank and file.
20% ARM; a wall that hides the Sauciers.
Leaper: lands in the back row and stays there.
Lifesteal 30%; the Course that punishes thin healing.
Packs of eight; chip damage adds up.
No damage; Chills ×1 whoever it hits.
Marks a cook: every enemy targets them for 4 s.
Each hit strips one buff or shield.

hordeBudget.clearNeeds: 500 usable damage per second over 180 s; the catalogue (Compendium v2) is cut so a table with two combos reaches 875 and a Menu reaches 999
hordeBudget.compendiumV2: Courses III and IV +30% HP, +20% ATK over v1 to absorb the everything-is-OP catalogue

champions.rule: One Champion every 100 kills. HP is set by the slot, identity by the daily shuffle; the Critic always takes slot 9 at 900 kills.

roster.trick: Charges the nearest cook and knocks it back a tile.
Pulls a back-row cook one tile forward every 8 s.
Slow and huge; every hit on it splashes 20% to adjacent cooks.
Three tentacles (a quarter of its HP each) count as separate kills; the body is untargetable until they are gone.
Lifesteal aura: enemies within a tile heal 20% of their damage.
Spawns two Cursed Cutlery every time it takes a crit.
Untargetable for 2 s every 10 s; hits Chill ×1.
Issues a citation: one random augment on one cook switches off for 10 s.
One of three moods. Bitter: hits strip Heat. Sour: heals the horde 5% on entry. Sweet: takes −30% until every other enemy on the field is dead.

conditions.rule: Three conditions a day, one per tier, rolled at 00:00 and shown on the lobby card. Tier I from the bell, Tier II from 500 kills, Tier III from 750 kills.

list.t: Everything on the field is Chilled ×1, cooks included.
Fifty extra Cupcakes queue up; each scores 2.
Every Course pours one a second faster.
The floor burns everyone 1% per second, both sides.
The back row is targetable by melee.
Signatures cost 70 Heat; every cast brings the next Champion 5 kills early.
At 1:00 and 2:00 every unit on the field is knocked back a tile.
Course IV pours at 12 a second.

augments.offer: Three cards: one Pantry, one Facet of your gem, one Signature of your class. Take one; it locks for the day. A held augment can be offered again and tiers up: Common → Rare → Epic, about ×1.7 a tier.
augments.special: Before the bell, one Special of three, fight only. Four in Leftovers hour.
augments.catalogue: Table Wars Compendium v2.dc.html · Part C
compendiumEdits: Leftover Night and Last Word reference Service; Service is retired in v2 — Leftover Night scores 2 a Cupcake, Last Word fires the Signature once more on falling.

tuning.metric: Fresh table kills (one augment, first fight)
Course reached by a fresh table
Full-loadout fights with a cook down before the end
Full-loadout fights with three or more down
Class × gem kill share against the median
